instruction: Install the VS Code extension from the VSIX file located at '/home/user/test.vsix' using the command line.

metadata.explanation: Paraphrased instruction specifying 'using the command line'. Same evaluator as original, checking extension is installed.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical command syntax error: The command uses array format with pipe operator which will not work correctly
The command ['code', '--list-extensions', '|', 'grep', 'undefined_publisher.test'] passes pipe as a literal argument, not as a shell operator
The getter get_vm_command_line uses shell=False by default, which means pipe operators won't be interpreted
This will cause runtime failure - the command will either error or return incorrect results
The verification logic concept is correct (list extensions and check if target is present), but the implementation is broken
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Option 1: Change command to single string with shell enabled: {"command": "code --list-extensions | grep undefined_publisher.test", "shell": true}
Option 2 (recommended): Remove pipe and grep, use just "command": ["code", "--list-extensions"] and let the metric search through full output - this is more robust
Option 3: Verify the VSIX file metadata to confirm 'undefined_publisher.test' is the correct extension ID
